CompanyDescription.label: Company Description
CompanyDescription.value: Wabtec Corporation is revolutionizing the way the world moves for future generations. The Company is a leading global provider of equipment, systems, digital solutions and value-added services for the freight and transit rail industries, as well as the mining, marine and industrial markets. Wabtec has been a leader in the rail industry for more than 155 years and has a vision to achieve an efficient rail system in the U.S. and worldwide.
